post.caption: A goldsmith built Florence's giant dome. Filippo Brunelleschi trained as a goldsmith as a teenager, and around 1400 he made small silver figures for an altar. In 1401 seven artists competed to make the Baptistery doors. The two finalists were both trained goldsmiths, and Lorenzo Ghiberti won the commission. In 1420 work began on his dome for Florence Cathedral, and it was finished in 1436, apart from the lantern. Over four million bricks went into it. Many sources call it the largest masonry dome ever built. His hoist ran on oxen and could reverse without turning them.
